name: timesheet-tracker
description: Gestionnaire de feuilles de temps - time tracker for Odoo timesheets
author: KreAddis

scripts.build:server-bundle: esbuild server/src/app.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=electron/server-bundle.mjs --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.dev:electron: npm run build:server-bundle && concurrently -k "npm run dev:client" "electron . --dev"
scripts.build:app: npm run build:client && npm run build:server-bundle && electron-builder
scripts.release: npm run build:client && npm run build:server-bundle && electron-builder --publish always
scripts.install:app: pkill -f 'Gestionnaire de feuilles de temps' || true; pkill -f 'Tempo.app' || true; sleep 1; rm -rf '/Applications/Tempo.app'; cp -R 'dist-electron/mac-arm64/Gestionnaire de feuilles de temps.app' /Applications/ && open '/Applications/Gestionnaire de feuilles de temps.app'
